messages:
maya: quick sketch: vertical project rows + time axis on top. each row shows a sparkline, 30d token usage, and a chevron to open a right-side flyout with invoice list and token breakdown. figma: https://redwood.app/s/compact-tl :sparkles:

darren: prefer auto-collapse for low-activity projects. otherwise long lists are noisy. also suggest a sticky org total at the top.

sarah: a11y: sparklines must meet contrast in dark mode and have aria-labels describing peak date. avoid hover-only controls.

kevin: export needs: per-row CSV + bulk download for invoices. make download buttons in flyout and delay fetching PDFs until click. add aria-labels with invoice number and amount.

maya: agreed. default: flyout shows recent invoice header (PDF icon + date), token summary (text/embed/rerank) and actions: Download PDF, Export CSV, Open billing page.

darren: perf note: virtualization + lazy fetch on expand. return only summary in timeline API and a details_url for flyout fetch.

sarah: copy tweaks: "Token usage" (not Token count) and "Projected spend (30d)". use ISO dates for invoices (YYYY-MM-DD).

kevin: keyboard: chevron focusable, Enter/Space opens flyout, Escape closes, focus trap inside. use aria-expanded and aria-controls.

billing-bot: New invoice available: rwd-20260401-900 ($2,345.67) -> https://billing.redwood/invoices/rwd-20260401-900 :receipt:

maya: good — I'll mock two variants: flyout (default) and inline-most-recent (power users). will include keyboard prototype and lightweight API contract and share tomorrow AM. :rocket:
